abstention.detail: Reviewed `Ideal.cotangentEquivIdeal_symm_apply`; the new proof uses `symm_apply_eq`/`ext`/`simp`, compiles, and removes prior elaboration/timeouts without introducing naming/style/documentation issues.
Tried a couple further golfs (dropping `rw` via `simp`/`simpa`, and avoiding `ext`) but they did not compile; the current `rw; ext; simp` proof is already minimal/idiomatic in context.

candidates.claim: In `Ideal.cotangentEquivIdeal_symm_apply`, the proof does a manual `rw [I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm_apply_eq]; ext; simp` even though `symm_apply_eq` is an `Iff` tailor-made for this goal, so the proof can be expressed canonically as `simpa using (I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm_apply_eq ...).2 ...`.
candidates.concern_label: use `simpa using (symm_apply_eq).2` instead of `rw; ext; simp`

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem cotangentEquivIdeal_symm_apply (x : R) (hx : x ∈ I) :
    I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm ⟨(I ^ 2).mkQ x, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx⟩ =
      I.toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
  simpa using
    (I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm_apply_eq
          (x := ⟨(I ^ 2).mkQ x, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx⟩) (y := I.toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩)).2
      (by
        ext
        simp)

candidates.requested_change: Rewrite the proof of `Ideal.cotangentEquivIdeal_symm_apply` to use `simpa using (I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm_apply_eq ...).2` with an `ext; simp` side goal, rather than rewriting by `symm_apply_eq` and then finishing manually.
